documents.title: Intake pilot notes
documents.text:
The intake pilot reduced handling time by a third across the first quarter.

The pilot ran in two regions and covered about four hundred cases.

Agents asked for more training on the new intake form.

documents.title: Intake pilot notes
documents.text:
The pilot did not change handling time, according to the early read of the first month.

The early read covered only sixty cases and was later corrected.

documents.title: Operations handbook
documents.text:
Handling time is measured from the moment a case is opened until the moment it is closed.

The measure excludes time spent waiting on a customer reply.

documents.title: Internal audit 2026
documents.text:
The audit found no evidence that handling time fell during the pilot window.

The sample was drawn from a different queue than the pilot covered.

documents.title: Canteen memo
documents.text:
The canteen will close at three on Friday for a private event.

Sandwiches will be available in the lobby.

documents.title: Globex benchmark
documents.text: Globex reports handling time is not measured the same way, so the comparison is not meaningful.
